# A Board for the Boat

*Corrie writes her notes on the back of her hand because there is nothing to write on in a pilot boat. Thin out 40 Driftstumps and bring her 10 Sound Driftwood for a board.*

|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Driftstump](../monsters/driftstump.md)
